title: Healthcare ke liye open AI model - Ling Sante kya kar sakta hai
content:
Ek naya AI model aaya hai jo sirf healthcare ke liye bana hai, aur iske weights bilkul open hain.
Naam hai Ling three point zero flash Sante.
Ise inclusionAI ne banaya hai, jo Ant Group ki AI research team hai.
Sante ek French word hai, matlab health.
Model mein total one hundred twenty four billion parameters hain.
Lekin har token pe sirf five point one billion active hote hain.
That is why it can be efficient while still being large.
Aur ye two hundred fifty six thousand tokens tak ka context handle karta hai, matlab lambi research reports ek saath.
License hai MIT. Iska matlab weights download karke aap research aur products dono mein try kar sakte ho.
Lekin ek baat bahut important hai, aur ye khud team ne likhi hai.
Ye ek research model hai, MEDICAL DEVICE NAHI.
Ye khud se diagnosis, prescription ya treatment decide nahi kar sakta. Every high-stakes answer needs review by a qualified professional.
Toh phir ye kis kaam ka hai?
Model card khud use cases batata hai. Medical literature search, lambe documents se information nikalna, aur healthcare knowledge-base apps.
Yaani wahi RAG wala kaam, jahan AI aapke documents se jawab deta hai.
Maan lo ek hospital ke paas sau se zyada SOP documents hain, jaise ICU protocols aur infection control rules.
Staff ko sahi page dhoondhne mein time lagta hai.
Aisa model un documents se sahi section nikaal ke de sakta hai, aur final decision doctor ya nurse hi lete hain.
Use kaise karein? Step one, sirf research ya internal testing se shuru karo. Step two, patient ka personal data bina permission ke kabhi mat daalo. Step three, har jawab ko trusted source se VERIFY karo.
Mera take simple hai. Healthcare mein AI ka sabse bada kaam doctor ko replace karna nahi, unka SEARCH TIME BACHANA hai.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
